### Eric Alsac's Executive Work History

### Eric Alsac's Biography

Eric Alsac is the Vice President, Consumer Healthcare at Norgine.
Eric joined Norgine in 2014 as a Global Commercial Intelligence Manager. Since then, he has undertaken a variety of roles within the Commercial Function in the United Kingdom and most recently, in The Netherlands as General Manager.
Prior to Norgine, Eric worked as a Business Analyst at Ipsen in France and Walgreens Boots Alliance in the United Kingdom.
Eric holds a Doctor of Pharmacy degree from the University of Lille and a Masters in Marketing from HEC Paris.

Source: [NORGINE PHARMACEUTICALS LIMITED](https://norgine.com/our-management-structure/) on 07/14/2023
